## Install: pick one

**Installer (.pkg): puts PomTiempo straight into Applications**
1. Download **PomTiempo-x.y.z.pkg** and double-click it.
2. macOS will say it can't check the developer. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down, click **Open Anyway**, then follow the installer.
3. Open PomTiempo from Applications or Launchpad. No further prompt.

**Disk image (.dmg): drag and drop**
1. Download **PomTiempo-x.y.z.dmg**, open it, and drag **PomTiempo** onto **Applications**.
2. The first time, **right-click PomTiempo → Open** (or Privacy & Security → *Open Anyway*).

Allow notifications when asked, or later in Settings → Notifications.

## Privacy

PomTiempo never connects to the internet. It runs in the macOS App Sandbox with **no network entitlement**, so macOS blocks any connection attempt. There's no updater, analytics or account. Settings stay on your Mac.

Universal build: Apple silicon and Intel, macOS 14 Sonoma or later. Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
